description: Durable owner record for the 942 origin/heal/fleet-gate-* remote branches from the 2026-07-03 heal loop. disposition.rationale: Each of the 942 heal/fleet-gate-* branches is a single non-equivalent 2026-07-03 heal-loop auto-fix commit. Main fleet-gate is green, so the red target no longer reproduces; every tip is preserved as ancestry of the archive ref below, so no unique content is lost when the live refs are reaped.
